detachments.name: Forgefather's Seekers

rule.name: Vulkan's Quest
rule.rules_text: You can select the Devastator Doctrine one additional time per battle. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units' ranged attacks that target a unit within 12 inches have +1 to Wound rolls. If your army includes VULKAN HE'STAN, friendly INFERNUS SQUAD units can start an action after an Advance or Fall Back move and can shoot while starting an action.

restrictions: Your army can include SALAMANDERS units, but it cannot include ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

enhancements.name: Forged in Battle
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit can ignore modifiers to its BS, WS and Hit rolls.

enhancements.name: Adamantine Mantle
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. Attacks allocated to this model have -1 Damage.

enhancements.name: War-tempered Artifice
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This model's melee attacks have +1 Strength and +1 Damage.

enhancements.name: Immolator
enhancements.rules_text: ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only. This unit's [TORRENT] weapons have +1 Attack.

stratagems.name: Blazing Earth
stratagems.when: Start of your opponent's Charge phase.
stratagems.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.
stratagems.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12 inches of your unit. That enemy unit has +1 to Charge rolls.

stratagems.name: Wrath and Ruin
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.effect: The Assault Doctrine or Tactical Doctrine is active for your unit until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagems.name: Forged in Fire
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's Torrent weapons do not have Blast, have Close Quarters, and have +1 Attack.

stratagems.name: Immolation Protocols
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged Torrent attacks have +1 AP.

stratagems.name: Crucible of Battle
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6 inches.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's attacks can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

stratagems.name: Burning Vengeance
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
stratagems.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that transport.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Disembark move and shoot using normal shooting, but can only target that enemy unit.

abilities.name: Lord of the Pyroclasts
abilities.rules_text: While an enemy unit is engaged with this unit, that enemy unit has -1 OC.

abilities.name: Unto the Anvil
abilities.rules_text: This unit's melee attacks can re-roll Wound rolls of 1. If the Assault Doctrine is active for this unit, those attacks can re-roll Wound rolls.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the following units: Assault Intercessor Squad, Bladeguard Veteran Squad, Company Heroes, Infernus Squad, Intercessor Squad, Sternguard Veteran Squad, Tactical Squad.

abilities.name: Seeker of the Unfound
abilities.rules_text: The first time this model is set up, select one objective. While within range of it, this model has OC 10, Leadership 5+ and Feel No Pain 4+.

abilities.name: Forgefather
abilities.rules_text: In your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 24 inches. Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units' [MELTA]/[TORRENT] attacks that target that enemy unit have +2 Strength.

leader.rules_text: This model can be attached to the listed Salamanders infantry units.
